blocks.text: Your January hours are still open in the timesheet book, and the January book closes on Friday. Please post everything through the end of last week before then. The book is on the front desk this week, not in the workroom.
A few of the entries already filed carry no search code. There is no way to tell which file they sit against, so put the code in as you post the rest of the month.
The monthly summary is compiled from the book on the first working day after it closes. It is only ever as good as what is in there by Friday afternoon.
